definition: One of the four parts of the year, or a period of activity.
example: Spring is my favourite season.

definition: The amount of space between two places.
example: The distance is about ten kilometres.

definition: A duty that you must deal with.
example: Cleaning the lab is his responsibility.

definition: At any time that you like.
example: Call me whenever you need help.
exampleTr: Yardıma ihtiyacın olduğunda ne zaman olursa ara.

definition: A series of steps that produce a result.
example: Learning a language is a slow process.

definition: A long sharp weapon with a handle.
example: The museum displays an old sword.

definition: Extremely small.
example: A tiny insect landed on the page.

definition: Something a person owns, or a quality of a material.
example: The property includes a large garden.
exampleTr: Mülk büyük bir bahçeyi de kapsıyor.

definition: To go and live somewhere, or to end an argument.
example: They settled in Bursa after the war.

definition: To cut into something with your teeth.
example: The dog bit the postman.

definition: To ask someone questions for a job or a report.
example: They interviewed six candidates.

definition: Medical treatment in which a doctor cuts the body.
example: He needs surgery on his shoulder.

definition: The elected leader of a city or a town.
example: The mayor opened the new library.

definition: A polite word for a man.
example: A gentleman is waiting at reception.

definition: A division into parts, or a break between people.
example: The split in the party surprised nobody.

definition: To make someone suddenly worried or frightened.
example: The news alarmed the whole village.

definition: Serving as a perfect example of something.
example: It is a model school for the region.

definition: To make a copy of a system, or to display clothes.
example: Scientists modelled the spread of the disease.

definition: One of the five parts at the end of your hand.
example: She cut her finger on the glass.

definition: The right or the chance to use something.
example: Students have access to the archive.

definition: Level and smooth, with no high parts.
example: We camped on flat ground.
